scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'd like to check on the status of my housing loan application. Could you please let me know if my application has been approved, denied, or if it's still pending?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your question. Your housing loan application has been approved, and your loan has been successfully originated.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for letting me know—I'm glad to hear my application was approved! 

Can you tell me what my interest rate is, and what the total costs of this loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.75%. The total costs associated with your loan are $3,017.69.

dialogue.user: Thanks for the information. Could you please tell me if there are any high-cost (HOEPA) flags or negative amortization features on my loan? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution at this point?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have any negative amortization features. According to the record, your loan has not been transferred or sold to another institution—it remains with the original lender.

dialogue.user: That’s great to hear—thank you for clarifying those details. One last question: can you confirm the type of loan product I was approved for, and what my debt-to-income ratio means for my application?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for a conventional first lien loan. Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is in the range of 30% to less than 36%. This percentage represents the ratio of your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income, as considered in the credit decision for your application.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for all of the clear answers. I appreciate how you explained what my DTI ratio means and confirmed the specifics on my loan type and status. Everything was communicated directly and with respect for my questions. <Satisfied> 

I’m satisfied because I got all the information I needed in a professional, straightforward way and now feel confident about my new loan!
